title: Audit conditioning, gradient noise and optimizer decisions

stages.title: Derive and check the local geometry
stages.evidence: Changed-shape loss, gradient, Hessian and independent directional checks
stages.expected: PASS stage 1 and all earlier stages
stages.diagnosis: Keep the one-half and mean factors consistent; compare actual residuals before debugging autodiff.

stages.title: Change coordinates without changing predictions
stages.evidence: Training-only RMS, mapped weights and measured Hessian condition
stages.expected: PASS stage 2 and all earlier stages
stages.diagnosis: Use training scales on held-out rows and map weights back before comparing predictions.

stages.title: Measure noise by enumerating the sampler
stages.evidence: Exact batch mean/covariance and uneven-batch weighting diagnosis
stages.expected: PASS stage 3 and all earlier stages
stages.diagnosis: Declare with-replacement sampling and count every ordered draw; do not average unequal batches equally.

stages.title: Audit optimizer state and update order
stages.evidence: NumPy-matched GD/momentum/Adam trajectories, clipping, schedules and divergent step
stages.expected: PASS stage 4 and all earlier stages
stages.diagnosis: Separate raw gradients, optimizer directions and parameter updates; compare post-update MSE on the same rows.

stages.title: Separate prediction and coefficient stability
stages.evidence: Rank-deficient ridge oracle, sensitivity perturbation and validation-selected penalty
stages.expected: PASS stage 5 and all earlier stages
stages.diagnosis: A small prediction error does not identify each coefficient; never select the penalty with test results.

rubric: Derive loss, gradient and Hessian independently of autodiff
Explain a coordinate change through prediction and curvature evidence
Distinguish exact minibatch expectation from an observed noisy update
Compare retained optimizer state and clipping/schedule order using identical examples
Separate coefficient identification, prediction quality and validation/test roles
setupNote: Run from the extracted bundle’s top folder with requirements-cpu.txt installed. Complete the initial regression audit before this deeper five-stage optimization audit.
